segments.name: Brokerage
segments.description: Commission-free investing and trading platforms for retail customers, offering equities, options, futures, event contracts and retirement accounts.
segments.evidence: Our platforms allow our customers to invest commission-free in U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs, as well as related options and ADRs.

revenueModel.text: Market makers pay for routed user orders, while customers pay commissions on futures and event contracts, Gold subscription fees, and interest on margin loans and Cash Sweep.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily earn transaction-based revenues from routing user orders for options, cryptocurrencies, and equities to market makers when the performance obligation is satisfied, which is at the point in time when a routed order is executed by the market maker.
